_comment: Test-customer guard (batch-2 item 5). Every SQL function whose name looks like a report/KPI/count/incentive/lead-queue function must be listed in exactly one of: must_exclude (its latest migration definition must reference is_test / is_test_customer / _invoice_is_test / _ticket_is_test / _visit_is_test) or exempt (with a reason). Checked by src/lib/testCustomerGuard.test.ts so a new aggregating function cannot ship without an explicit decision.

exempt.report_top_customers: reads only through _report_invoice_base, which excludes flagged customers
exempt.compute_salary: sums incentives_earned and salary rows only; no customer-linked data
exempt._org_active_master_count: counts active master profiles (last-master guard); no customer-linked data
exempt.report_spare_handover_discrepancy: records a technician's disputed hand-over quantity and notifies staff; no customer-linked data at all
exempt.customer_filter_counts: mixed, not full exclusion: total excludes is_test customers (is_test = false); hasAmc, amcDueSoon and dormant do not -- documented known gap carried over unchanged from the client-side code this replaced, see docs/backlog-product-gaps.md 'Customers quick-filter counts don't exclude test customers consistently'
